metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Bert Palette
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Bert Palette takes the role of art teacher. “That gray has a lot to say.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small paint palette with three smooth color dabs and stubby brush.

records.name: Nora Offbeat
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Nora Offbeat takes the role of music teacher. “The pause counts too.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small metronome with a chunky swinging arm.

records.name: Ned Stagewink
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Ned Stagewink takes the role of drama teacher. “Give the silence a bigger entrance.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: single hand-held half mask with a raised eyebrow, real face visible.

records.name: Tess Relay
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Tess Relay takes the role of physical education teacher. “The baton is the easy part.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short relay baton and one small stopwatch.

records.name: Gus Doughrise
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Gus Doughrise takes the role of home economics teacher. “The dough did its homework.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small mixing bowl with a rising lump and blunt wooden spoon.

records.name: Ollie Jointfit
records.biography_en: In The Practice Rooms, Ollie Jointfit takes the role of craft teacher. “Let the corners meet first.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one pair of oversized wooden dovetail pieces fitted partway together.
